mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_document(source_type, url, title, published_at, fetched_at, content_hash, content) VALUES(#{sourceType}, #{url}, #{title}, #{publishedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{contentHash}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.theme_id, m.metric_code, m.as_of_date, m.published_at, m.value, m.unit, m.source_document_id, m.created_at, m.updated_at, d.title, d.url FROM industry_metric m JOIN theme t ON t.id=m.theme_id JOIN source_document d ON d.id=m.source_document_id WHERE t.code=#{code} AND m.as_of_date<=#{date} AND m.published_at<#{cutoff} AND d.published_at<#{cutoff} ORDER BY m.as_of_date DESC LIMIT 100
